_comment: CI-realistic Lighthouse gate. Production target per EXP-24 is performance >= 0.9 on a CDN-hosted mobile profile; CI medians ~0.67 because Lighthouse simulate-mode penalises serial ES-module fetches that production HTTP/2 multiplexes away (compounded by GH Actions runner variance — individual runs swing 0.20+ points). The hard, deterministic invariant is the 250 KB gzipped bundle-weight gate in tests/bundle-weight.test.mjs; this Lighthouse assertion is a drift alarm, not the spec.
